1. Introduction

Welcome to KnowChamp ("we", "our", "us"). We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal and gameplay information. This Privacy Policy governs your use of the KnowChamp mobile application and web portal.

2. Information We Collect

To provide a fair, competitive, and secure quiz gaming experience, we collect the following categories of information:

  • Account & Profile Details: Full name, username, mobile phone number, email address, date of birth, and avatar selection.
  • Gameplay & Tournament Analytics: Contest participation history, response speed, accuracy rates, leaderboard rankings, and tournament achievements.
  • Wallet & Financial Transactions: Entry fee transactions, prize pool winnings, withdrawal records, and payout identifiers (e.g., UPI ID, Bank Account details) for prize distributions.
  • Device & Security Data: IP address, device model, operating system, and geolocation data (used strictly to enforce regional contest eligibility and anti-cheat policies).

3. How We Use Your Information

  • Facilitating real-time quiz matchmaking and live tournament score computation.
  • Crediting prize pool winnings, bonuses, and processing instant wallet withdrawals.
  • Ensuring fair-play compliance and detecting unauthorized bots, emulators, or multi-accounting.
  • Delivering personalized contest recommendations, push notifications, and customer support.

4. Fair Play & Anti-Fraud Monitoring

KnowChamp employs automated security algorithms to analyze in-game response patterns. Any suspicious automation or fraudulent activity will result in account review and potential prize forfeiture.

5. Data Protection & Security

We implement 256-bit SSL encryption and strict server access controls to ensure your financial and personal data remains protected against unauthorized access.

6. Contact & Privacy Requests

For inquiries regarding data protection, consent withdrawal, or account deletion, contact our privacy team at privacy@knowchamp.com or through the in-app Support Center.

1. Contest Organizers & Quiz Hosts Overview

This Privacy Policy outlines how KnowChamp collects, uses, and safeguards information provided by verified quiz creators, tournament hosts, and content moderators on our platform.

2. Host Verification & Payout Data

To ensure content integrity and facilitate host revenue-sharing, we collect:

  • Identity & Tax Compliance: Government-issued ID, PAN details, and verified bank credentials for hosting commission payouts and TDS reporting.
  • Content Submissions: Question banks, answer keys, subject category tags, and reference explanations.
  • Host Activity Metrics: Contest creation history, player engagement statistics, and rating reviews.
  • KYC Verification: Host bank details, UPI ID and pan card upload verification status.

3. Content Ownership & Integrity

  • Question submissions must adhere to KnowChamp originality and copyright standards.
  • Host credentials and question bank repositories are secured with multi-factor authentication.

4. Host Support & Compliance

For questions regarding creator agreements or payout policies, reach out to partners@knowchamp.com.

1. Acceptance of Terms

By downloading, registering, or participating in quiz contests on KnowChamp, you agree to be legally bound by these Terms and Conditions and our Platform Rules.

2. Eligibility & Account Registration

  • Users must be at least 18 years of age (or have verified parental/guardian consent) to participate in cash prize tournaments.
  • Each player is entitled to maintain only one active KnowChamp account. Multi-accounting, emulator usage, or profile sharing is strictly prohibited.
  • Players from restricted jurisdictions where skill-based gaming is legally prohibited are not eligible to enter paid contests.

3. Contests, Entry Fees & Prize Pools

  • Contests require the payment of a specified entry fee or ticket prior to joining.
  • Entry fees are non-refundable once a contest countdown begins or questions are revealed.
  • Prize pools are distributed strictly according to official leaderboard rankings computed based on accuracy, score, and answering speed.
  • In case of a tie, the prize allocation follows the transparent tie-breaker protocol specified for that contest.

4. Wallet, Winnings & Withdrawals

  • Wallet balances consist of Deposit Balance, Bonus Cash, and Withdrawable Winnings.
  • Winnings can be withdrawn to verified UPI IDs or bank accounts subject to mandatory KYC verification.
  • KnowChamp complies with applicable tax regulations, including Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) on net winnings where mandated by law.

5. Fair Play & Anti-Cheating Policy

KnowChamp operates a zero-tolerance policy against cheating, automated scripts, screen mirroring tools, or collusion. Violations will result in immediate disqualification, permanent account banning, and forfeiture of all balances.

6. Limitation of Liability

KnowChamp is a game of knowledge, skill, and cognitive speed. We are not liable for gameplay disruptions arising from user connectivity issues, device failures, or third-party telecommunication interruptions.

1. Quiz Host & Partner Agreement

This Agreement governs your onboarding and engagement as approved Quiz Creators, Tournament Hosts, or Subject Experts on the KnowChamp platform.

2. Question Quality & Confidentiality

  • Hosts must ensure all submitted questions are factually accurate, unambiguous, and free from intellectual property infringement.
  • Leaking question sets or answer keys prior to contest conclusion is a severe breach resulting in immediate legal action and compensation claims.
  • KnowChamp reserves editorial rights to review, approve, modify, or reject any submitted content.

3. Host Revenue Share & Settlements

  • Host commission payouts are calculated based on contest participation volume minus platform hosting fees.
  • Settlements are processed weekly to verified bank accounts following anti-fraud review.

4. Account Termination

KnowChamp reserves the right to suspend or terminate host privileges for non-compliance with quality standards or community guidelines.

1. Refund & Cancellation Overview

At KnowChamp, we strive to ensure a fair, transparent, and seamless skill-based gaming environment. This Refund Policy sets out the terms under which refunds may be issued for contest entries, wallet deposits, and transactions on our platform.

2. Contest Entry Fee Refunds

  • Contest Cancellation by Platform: If a scheduled quiz contest is cancelled by KnowChamp due to technical issues, insufficient participation, or server maintenance, 100% of the entry fee paid will be automatically refunded to the user's wallet balance within 24 hours.
  • Disconnections & Server Disruptions: In the event of a verified server-side failure that disrupts live contest gameplay for all participants, entry fees will be refunded to affected users.
  • User-Side Connectivity Issues: KnowChamp is not liable for device crashes, network loss, or disconnections arising from user ISP problems once questions have been revealed. In such cases, entry fees are non-refundable.

3. Wallet Deposits & Payment Failures

  • If an amount is debited from your bank account/UPI but does not reflect in your KnowChamp wallet within 15 minutes, our automated reconciliation system will either credit the wallet or process a refund to the original payment method within 3–5 business days.
  • Accidental deposit refund requests can be submitted via the Support Center within 2 hours of transaction, provided the funds have not been utilized in any contest.

4. Processing Timelines & Modes

Approved refunds are routed back to the original payment source (UPI, Bank Account, Card) or credited directly to the KnowChamp Wallet Deposit balance within 3 to 7 business days depending on banking partner timelines.

5. Contact for Refund Queries

For refund disputes or transaction escalations, contact our finance team at refunds@knowchamp.com with your Transaction ID and registered User ID.

1. Contest Host Settlement & Cancellation Terms

This policy details the refund, cancellation, and fee adjustment guidelines applicable to verified Quiz Creators, Tournament Organizers, and Subject Experts hosting contests on KnowChamp.

2. Host Contest Cancellation & Penalties

  • If a host voluntarily cancels a scheduled contest after player registrations have opened, all collected player entry fees are 100% refunded to participants, and the host's platform reliability score may be adjusted.
  • Repeated unannounced cancellations may result in temporary suspension of contest hosting privileges.

3. Platform Fee Reversals

  • Platform commission fees charged to hosts for aborted or server-cancelled tournaments are fully waived and credited back to host accounts.

4. Dispute Resolution & Host Support

For questions regarding hosting payouts or fee reconciliations, reach out to partners@knowchamp.com.
